located.ask:
Is it useful to turn it into an iff? I think you get something like 
`DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) (s ∪ t) \iff DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) s ∧ \all x \in t, (Ici x \cap s).Nonempty ∨ [symmetric case]`
That at least makes the naming easy: `directedOn_union_iff`.

For this lemma, maybe `or_of_directedOn_union`? `directedOn_or_directedOn_of_directedOn_union` is more faithful, but (too?) long.

Otherwise LGTM
